title: Fraud Policy v4.8 — Automatic Block Rules
content: Automatically block card-not-present purchases above $4,000 when a new device and a foreign hosting IP are present. This policy was superseded by v6.2.

title: Fraud Policy v6.2 — High-Value Verification
content: For a high-value card-not-present purchase on a new device, require step-up authentication. Route the case to manual review when the network is foreign or hosted. Do not automatically block without additional evidence.

title: Historical Case ATO-118 — Confirmed Account Takeover
content: A four-year customer account placed a $5,200 camera order from a new device and Singapore hosting IP. Step-up authentication failed and the customer denied the purchase. Final verdict: account takeover.

title: Historical Case TRAVEL-041 — Legitimate Purchase
content: A long-standing customer purchased $4,600 in photography equipment while travelling in Asia. The device was new, but step-up authentication succeeded and delivery used a trusted home address. Final verdict: legitimate.
